errors.text_span: each labeled with its category, percentage, and absolute count
errors.evidence: The slices in the pie chart are labeled with the category and percentage only (e.g., "Medium (51.8%)"). The absolute counts are listed separately in the legend, not on the slices themselves.

errors.text_span: and each slice also has its percentage and count labeled directly on the chart
errors.evidence: This is a repetition of a previous error. The slices are not labeled with the absolute count; this information is only present in the legend.

errors.text_span: and proceeding clockwise to the smallest “Very easy” slice
errors.evidence: The segments are arranged in descending order of size when proceeding counter-clockwise from the largest slice ("Medium"). Proceeding clockwise from "Medium" leads directly to the smallest slice, "Very easy".
